safety: This build has NO real executor. All apply/undo/reset operations modify only SQLite simulation records. Never unlink/move/kill/control services/edit startup outside app-owned data.

api.GET /api/tasks: {tasks}; latest 15 durable tasks, current plan and event summaries
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}: {task}; status, goal, scopes, versioned plan, latest result, feedback and events
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/continue: {} -> {task,job_id}; continue a stopped or completed investigation
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/feedback: {message?,keep_ids?} -> {task,job_id}; save user intent, invalidate plan, investigate again
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/approve: {version,ids} -> {task,job_id}; explicit selection of exact plan, simulation apply/verify, continue model loop
api.POST /api/check: legacy compatibility only; no standalone UI entry; fixed known caches and partial inventories
api.GET /api/recommendations: {items:[original item + advice],groups,summary}; cached current model result or local rules
api.POST /api/recommendations/analyze: {} -> {items,groups,summary}; structured model advice if configured, rule fallback otherwise
api.POST /api/plan: {ids,action?,selection_mode?,snapshots?:{id:signature}} -> frozen plan; rejects stale provided signatures before approval
api.GET /api/files: {offset?,limit?:1..100,query?,scope?,risk?,revision?} -> bounded projected page; 409 catalog_changed on old revision
api.GET /api/providers: {presets,protocols,checked_at}; documented presets, no live vendor guarantee
api.POST /api/tasks/analyze: {section,ids? OR query?/scope?/risk?/kind?,depth?,goal?} -> {task,job_id}; frozen analysis selection, no execution approval
api.POST /api/developer: {enabled?:bool,clear?:bool}; defaults off, captures subsequent requests only
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/facts: {offset?,limit?:1..20,ids?:comma-separated fact IDs up to12} -> {items,total,offset,limit,has_more}; historical observations with scope/source/time/recheck rule
api.GET /api/skills/{id}: {cursor?} -> flat versioned content, sha256, sources, budget, next_cursor; allowlisted resources only
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/direct-plan: {ids:1..30,action,snapshots?} -> {task,plan}; user-origin versioned plan, approval via existing approve route
api.POST /api/ui-preferences: allowlisted preference subset -> {preferences}; persisted separately from model settings/capture
api.GET /api/icon: {id,v?} -> local image bytes, X-Panxu-Icon-Status:ready|pending|fallback; existing catalog IDs only; no arbitrary path; bounded private memory cache and async extraction
api.POST /api/preferences: {custom_instructions:string} -> {preferences,settings}; merges only shared model-independent preference, preserves connection and key
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream: {stream,volatile:true}; bounded sanitized public cumulative reply, never tool arguments or approval
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream/events: SSE default data:{stream}; 4 concurrent connections,25s lifetime, snapshots/keepalive; resume by epoch+sequence
api.POST /api/updates/check: {} -> {status,current_version,latest_version,release_url,message,checked_at,source,code,cached}; explicit manual read-only release discovery; current private source not_configured, no network; never downloads or installs

mutations: Require X-CSRF-Token from bootstrap. Errors are JSON {error,code}. Relative same-origin fetch only. Input limits apply.
summary: {total_items,visible_items,simulated_items,logical_bytes,simulated_bytes,process_memory_bytes,by_kind,source,mode}. Real disks separate; no simulated_bytes shown as actual freed space.
source: empty | local; normal startup contains no synthetic examples; fixtures require developer_fixtures=True at server creation
advice: {group:'recommended'|'personal'|'keep'|'review',title,purpose,reason,impact,auto_select,suggested_action,origin:'rule'|'model',needs_user_choice}; personal and unknown files never auto_select
plans: Risk protected cannot queue. Default action by item kind. Incomplete dirs disallowed. Existing simulated skip. Planned catalog revision bound, stale live signatures checked before execute. No raw arbitrary path actions.
privacy: No user file body read for LLM. Metadata only; send_paths false by default. No real provider key expected in tests. LLM cannot execute or approve plans.
agent_task: statuses ready/investigating/awaiting_review/executing/needs_input/needs_model/paused/budget_exhausted/error/completed. Up to 6 model responses and 12 tools per turn. Personal files default unchecked; unknown/protected/out-of-scope and stale plans cannot bypass factual checks. Tool text is untrusted.
action_runtime: simulation backend only. Per-item durable intent plus atomic overlay/receipt, status succeeded/failed/partial/cancelled/unverified. Recovery verifies receipts without blind replay. User undo is separately visible as current_state=undone. Actual reclaimed bytes always zero.
task_memory: Durable goal, choices, versioned plan, simulation receipts, up to300 historical facts/task with32MiB global fact-payload retention. Model connection change reconstructs fresh context, not private provider continuation. Request attempts/tools/work counted; missing provider token usage is unknown.
task_scan: ScanIndex durable name/metadata spool, stable keyset cursor; steps1..512, rows<=100000/scan. Interrupted unfinished enumeration replays with explicit work accounting; acquired rows retained. Whole-directory actions require separate current subtree validation. All22 tool schemas still sent each model turn; discover_tools is help, not lazy loading.
guidance: 17 fixed bundled markdown resources, version1.1.0, each max32KiB; list_skills/read_skill provide bounded guidance with versions/fingerprints/official sources. Guidance is not current evidence or extra execution permission.
user_actions: Model questions have independent monotonic versions; answers/skip durable but not approval. Host direct-plan preflights current identity in task scope, then same approve/runtime; source, chosen IDs, results flow back. Legacy manual history only intersects task-known IDs for model awareness.
license: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; Required Notice copyright 2026 Liss. Scope original PanXu material; third-party components retain their licenses. Explicit user choice 2026-11-02.
developer_dock: Closed by default; settings entry and F12 toggle. Same bounded capture/view filters in right-side dock; mounted independently of current task view. No auto capture when opening.
appearance: Default follows system; explicit saved light/dark preserved; live media changes apply without restart.
read_only_evidence: collect_system_configuration(section=memory_power) observes memory/active vs configured pagefiles/power via fixed APIs and7 registry values; inspect_volume(scope_id) observes only existing task-scope volume capacity/recycle statistics. No root or action targets added; unknown/partial explicit.
icons: Private known-ID local icon extraction from existing executable resources, desktop registration or stock/type fallback; visible lazy requests, bounded queues/cache, no shell extensions/shortcut resolution or LLM transmission. Icons do not certify publisher or ownership.
developer_readability: Visible-role text and public communication by default, one closed auxiliary section per event for system/context/facts/skills/tools/metadata/raw sanitized JSON. Protocol-private content stays excluded.
model_streaming: Four native protocols with real SSE aggregation; public cumulative previews independent of developer capture; partial tools never executable; cancel/disconnect/budget fail closed. Defaults on, JSON fallback labelled; spring grapheme UI respects reduced motion. Save precedes fixed-data connection test and failed test never rolls back saved settings.
visual_hierarchy: Platform Chinese typography, six text roles, shared semantic status labels, independent light/dark surfaces; recommendation/source and simulated results do not claim actual operation success. Presentation only, no extra execution authority.
